turns.question: What is OpsAtlas?
turns.reply: OpsAtlas is a local-first governed organisational knowledge and operating-intelligence platform. It combines approved document retrieval with structured knowledge to provide cited answers, process intelligence, governance workflows and analytics.

turns.question: Does everything run offline, including the avatar?
turns.reply: Core OpsAtlas knowledge processing and model inference run locally. The optional Digital SME uses Anam as a managed avatar and speech-rendering layer. Local core processing should not be described as a guarantee that every optional integration operates offline.
